problem: The sentence 'Only a few universities teach domain shift under this name' is an unverifiable claim about syllabi and is placed mid-paragraph where it breaks the flow; domain shift is in fact standard terminology in most machine learning texts.
fix: Replace with a plain statement of the term: 'Domain shift (also called distribution shift) means test data come from a different source than training data, such as a model trained on Delhi traffic applied to Chennai.' Drop the claim about universities.

problem: Precision, recall and F1 are used without definition, which breaks the rule of defining every term at first use; a second-language reader may not know what F1 is.
fix: Add one short clause: 'Precision is the fraction of flagged transactions that are truly fraud; recall is the fraction of true frauds that are flagged; F1 is their harmonic mean.'
